component.name: Ascension
component.summary: Real-time strategy from early history to an age of galactic empires

description.p: Lead a people through fourteen ages: found cities on a round planet, research at the library, trade on the market and raise armies, then build starships, claim resource worlds and cross between star systems by charged jumps along routes.
Nations grow into continental blocs and finally into united humanity. Play against computer opponents or with others over a network server.
